name: Dire Downdraft
description: This spell costs {1} less to cast if it targets an attacking or tapped creature. Target creature's owner puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
couldNotDerive: The cost reduction itself (S:ReduceCost -- known gap, no schema representation).

That the TARGET'S OWNER (not the caster) makes the top-or-bottom choice, and that it's a choice at all rather than a fixed position -- AlternativeDecider$/DestinationAlternative$/LibraryPositionAlternative$ aren't read at all, so the reconstruction just said "into its owner's library" with no position/choice info.
notes: Two real gaps: (1) S:ReduceCost, already a known backlog item (no schema representation for cost reduction). (2) A real, previously-unseen shape: AlternativeDecider$ names WHO makes a choice (here, the target's owner, not the caster) between two possible outcomes (DestinationAlternative$/LibraryPositionAlternative$ = top vs. bottom) -- entirely unread. Neither fixed this round; (2) is a genuinely new decision-maker/choice concept, not a quick field addition.
